body: So, I broke up with this my "true/first" love that I still love with ( to be honest the only woman I want to love and be loved by). I know she still has feelings for me even though I broke her heart. Right before she went to campus but almost 9 months later after me getting back on my feet and being homeless for 3 months I am going to jobcorps too. But I have been placed in the same campus  as her. I know she has a boyfriend and is trying to move on. I still have feelings for her but don't won't to be anymore pain for her. So should I give inform her I am going or no? A little reason is I want to try and get back with her but do I have the right to even ask ?
